summary: Fixed the detection pipeline's missing multibyte prober properties: MultiByteCharSetProber.charset_name now returns None instead of raising, and Big5, CP949, EUC-KR and GB2312 probers gained charset_name and language properties, which unblocked all 69 shard-5 tests. The last full-suite run I saw had 375 passed and 1 failed (test_detect_all_and_detect_one_should_agree, outside my shard, a hypothesis case returning None for '\x80𝀀'), with 6 xfailed and 1 xpassed.
